binary.coordinates: flat int16 longitude,latitude pairs at scaleDegrees
binary.header: 16 bytes little-endian: EHCN; uint16 schema,reserved; uint32 coordinatePairCount,reserved

coordinateEncoding.axisConvention: GPlates unit sphere: x=lon 0, y=lon 90E, z=north

epistemicStatus: source-native static continental material partition; rigid child-plate reconstruction

partitionContract.identity: source static continental feature and child reconstruction plate ID
partitionContract.overlap: first active containing fragment after deterministic area/source-order sort
partitionContract.priority: active reconstructed polygon area descending, matching pyGPlates SortPartitioningPlates.by_partition_type_then_plate_area
partitionContract.topology: instantaneous resolved topology is a containing stage and need not have the child fragment plate ID
